projecthero.omnitrix.jetray.neuroshock_e: A twin neuroshock beam from his eyes: 7 to the first creature in line (24 blocks).
projecthero.omnitrix.jetray.tail_blast.d: His tail arches over his shoulder and fires a neuroshock bolt (28 blocks): 14 and a 1 s stun.
Streak along your look at full speed: 15 to every creature you pass through, knocked aside.
projecthero.omnitrix.jetray.wing_slash.d: The wings sweep everything in front (4.5 blocks): 12 and shoved away.
projecthero.omnitrix.jetray.flight.desc: Take off or land. Jetray flies fast (double-tap jump works too).
A burst of speed along your look, in the air or under water.
projecthero.omnitrix.jetray.neuroshock_s: Five eye beams in a fan (16 blocks): 6 to the first creature in each.
A neuroshock ring bursts out round you (5 blocks): 13 and Slowness II for 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.jetray.streamline.d: Toggle: faster flight, Dolphin's Grace II in water and Speed II on the ground.
Sense every creature within 24 blocks: they glow for 8 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.jetray.thunder_dive: Climb, then plunge: the landing bursts with neuroshock (4 blocks), 19.
projecthero.omnitrix.jetray.neuroshock_o: ULTIMATE: 1 s held still as the eyes and tail charge, then a 30-block, 3-wide beam: 55 to everything in it.
projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.jetray: Jetray, the Aerophibian: a crimson manta ray built for high-speed flight through air, space and water, firing neuroshock blasts from his eyes and tail.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.jetray.role: Flier: high-speed flight, neuroshock beams and dive strikes.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.jetray.passive: Fast flight on X (or a double-tap of jump); transformed in mid-air, he is flying at once.
Aerophibian: in water he swims with Dolphin's Grace and never drowns.
No fall damage and no fly-into-wall damage.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.jetray.weaknes: His beams need a clear line: the first block stops them.
Neuroshock Overload holds him still for a whole second.
